questions.questionTextEn: For which values of the real parameter p does the alternating series Σ_{n=2}^∞ (−1)^n / (n (ln n)^p) converge conditionally?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Convergence of Infinite Series • IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
के लिए which values of the real parameter p does the alternating श्रेणी (series) Σ_{n=2}^∞ (−1)^n / (n (ln n)^p) converge conditionally?
questions.explanationEn: By the Alternating Series Test (Leibniz criterion), 1/(n (ln n)^p) decreases monotonically to 0 for all p ≥ 0, so the series converges for p ≥ 0. By the Integral Test, Σ 1/(n (ln n)^p) converges absolutely only for p > 1. Hence it converges conditionally for 0 ≤ p ≤ 1.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
By the Alternating Series Test (Leibniz criterion), 1/(n (ln n)^p) decreases monotonically to 0 for all p ≥ 0, so the series converges for p ≥ 0. By the Integral Test, Σ 1/(n (ln n)^p) converges absolutely only for p > 1. Hence it converges conditionally for 0 ≤ p ≤ 1.

questions.questionTextHi:
[Vector Calculus / Line Integral (Green's Theorem) • IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —

questions.questionTextEn: The exact sum of the infinite series Σ_{n=1}^∞ (2n + 1) / (n² (n + 1)²) is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:

The exact sum of the infinite श्रेणी (series) Σ_{n=1}^∞ (2n + 1) / (n² (n + 1)²) is ________.
questions.explanationEn: Since (2n + 1) / (n² (n + 1)²) = 1/n² − 1/(n + 1)², the series telescopes: S_N = 1/1² − 1/(N + 1)² → 1 as N → ∞.

questions.questionTextEn: Let A = [[2, 1, 0], [0, 2, 1], [0, 0, 2]] be a 3 × 3 Jordan block. The sum of the algebraic multiplicity and the geometric multiplicity of the eigenvalue λ = 2 is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Linear Algebra (Geometric Multiplicity) • IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
माना कि A = [[2, 1, 0], [0, 2, 1], [0, 0, 2]] be a 3 × 3 Jordan block. The sum of the algebraic multiplicity and the geometric multiplicity of the आइगेनमान (eigenvalue) λ = 2 is ________.
questions.explanationEn: The characteristic polynomial is (λ − 2)³, so the algebraic multiplicity of λ = 2 is 3. Since Rank(A − 2I) = Rank([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[0,0,0]]) = 2, the geometric multiplicity is 3 − 2 = 1. Their sum is 3 + 1 = 4.

questions.questionTextEn: If the orthogonal trajectory to the family of parabolas y = c x² passing through the point (√2, 1) intersects the y-axis at (0, y0) with y0 > 0, then y0² is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Differential Equations (Orthogonal Trajectories) • IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
यदि the orthogonal trajectory to the family of parabolas y = c x² passing through the point (√2, 1) intersects the y-axis at (0, y0) with y0 > 0, then y0² is ________.
questions.explanationEn: For y = c x², dy/dx = 2cx = 2y/x. Replacing dy/dx by −dx/dy gives the orthogonal trajectory ODE: dy/dx = −x/(2y) => 2y dy + x dx = 0 => x² + 2y² = K. Passing through (√2, 1) gives 2 + 2(1)² = 4, so at x = 0, 2 y0² = 4 => y0² = 2.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (2.0..2.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
For y = c x², dy/dx = 2cx = 2y/x. Replacing dy/dx by −dx/dy gives the orthogonal trajectory ODE: dy/dx = −x/(2y) => 2y dy + x dx = 0 => x² + 2y² = K. Passing through (√2, 1) gives 2 + 2(1)² = 4, so at x = 0, 2 y0² = 4 => y0² = 2.

questions.questionTextEn: In the alternating group A_5 (of order 60), the index [A_5 : H] of a subgroup H isomorphic to the Klein four-group V_4 is ________.

प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —

questions.questionTextEn: Let A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]. If A² − 5A + k I = 0 where I is the 2 × 2 identity matrix, then the real scalar k is equal to ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Linear Algebra (Cayley-Hamilton Theorem) • IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
माना कि A = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]. यदि A² − 5A + k I = 0 where I is the 2 × 2 identity आव्यूह (matrix), then the real scalar k के बराबर है ________.
questions.explanationEn: By Cayley-Hamilton Theorem, A² − Trace(A) A + det(A) I = 0. Here Trace(A) = 5 and k = det(A) = 4 − 6 = −2.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (-2.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
By Cayley-Hamilton Theorem, A² − Trace(A) A + det(A) I = 0. Here Trace(A) = 5 and k = det(A) = 4 − 6 = −2.
